Results.ReviewText: Love it. Only thing close to a complaint for me is the ash catcher can sometimes be difficult to get in and out.
Results.Title: Copper 22" Premium Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Even Grilling, Excellent for smoking.Total control of heat.
Results.Title: Grill or Smoke, it does it all. Direct or indirect

Results.ReviewText: Great bbq. Very easy to use and control temps. Had a small issue during shipping where the lid was damaged and you stood by your product and shipped me a new lid. Great grill. Great company.
Results.Title: 22in Weber

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill. Been great for everything from burgers and dogs to tri tip and chicken.
Results.Title: Perfect for beginners

Results.ReviewText: It would have been nice if all of the parts had arrived in one box, but it took a long phone call and another week or so for all of the parts to arrive. I hauled my old huge Weber to Australia years ago, so I’m a fan. This one is green, which just looks beautiful!
Results.Title: I’ve always wanted one of these

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber kettle grill.  It’s easy to control the temperature and love using it as a smoker. This is the only charcoal grill I’d ever purchase
Results.Title: Weber kettle 22inch charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: 1st timing using since i bought grill, smoked a roast it turned out real good .
Results.Title: Grilling and Smoking

Results.ReviewText: This is a premium charcoal grill that is easy to assemble and use. It was easy to control the temperature and my food tasted great.
Results.Title: I highly recommend this grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber kettle grill in 10 years and as always they do it all perfectly. Give better taste than anything out there. Go buy 1 or 2!!!
Results.Title: All around perfect

Results.ReviewText: Great piece of equipment for any level of chef. Can’t beat the simplicity of the original.
Results.Title: Quality purposeful equipment.

We reached out to you via email so that we can make this right for you ASAP. We look forward to helping you soon.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Grill came with handle welded in an impossible spot and the other handles are unable to be put on.
Results.Title: Poor Quality Control

Results.ReviewText: It’s well suited for a senior citizen couple who are no longer cooking for a large family.
Results.Title: Down sizing

Results.ReviewText: Love the results so far! The grill has been a steady go to about every night. I have even had success with setting it up for a couple of slow, smokey cooks (pork butt, ribs). Heat is easy to regulate and the kettle looks great! I am not sure why I stayed with a gas grill for so long.
Results.Title: Great grill and great value!

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: J’ai acheté ce bbq la semaine dernière et il est brisé. Il est arrivé  bosseler à deux endroits et on voit les marques de soudures à l extérieur. Je l aime ,il est super beau mais quand on paie pour du neuf on s attends à recevoir le produit en parfait état.je recommande ce produit puisque qu’il fonctionne très bien mais je suis extrêmement déçu de le recevoir brisé.c’est moi qui l’a acheté pour cadeau à mon conjoint! Alors c’est mon conjoint qui l’utilise .
Results.Title: Coque brisé

Results.ReviewText: When I lived in an apartment I used to use a Smokey Joe.  I then purchased several gas grills and set the charcoal aside.  Had a family and went to use SJ but realized it was not nearly big enough to feed 8 people. I received the 22" and it is awesome.  Its nice to be able, with the correct timing, to cook an entire meal on this grill. I highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Replacing a Smokey Joe with 22" Premium.

Results.ReviewText: I gave this as a gift to my dad for Father's Day to replace his 40 year old Weber charcoal grill. Both he and my mom absolutely love it and the copper color is spectacular! Simplicity at its finest, but so effective!
Results.Title: LOVE!

Results.ReviewText: This is and update from the one posted on Amazon. The unit works beautifully, so far this past holiday weekend we BBQed everyday even in 100 degree heat. It kept a uniform temp throughout the entire session. Easy to clean especially the ash bin, worse jab of all for me. I would recommend this Weber. ONE NOTE: the packaging came damaged resulting in a ding on the lid mating surface.
Results.Title: Best possible at a reasonable price

Results.ReviewText:
I'm grill poor. Have a Brinkman and Cuisinart smoker, a one stack rectangle grill and a 50 gal. two stack grill. 

With the Weber I ordered the charcoal side bins which is a have to have addition making indirect cooking a cinch. This unit is almost completely air tight. When all vents are closed after cooking it shuts down quickly which saves charcoal. I noticed that when shut down the temp will drop from 300-350 to less than 100 in about 10 minutes allowing to keep the food warm without overcooking. From now on this will be my main go-to cooker.
Results.Title: Grill poor.

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber Grill, it’s so easy to use and it’s the perfect size for large or small numbers of guest. I waited too long to get it!
Results.Title: Love it, Love it, Love it

Results.ReviewText:
I love it. The design is retro looking yet simple and sleek. The only thing its missing is a side table. With that it would be perfect. Cost was quite reasonable as well.

Is it a pain in the butt to use charcoal and wood? Sure. It can be.. but its worth it, let me tell you. The flavour and juiciness is superior using the above said mediums.
Results.Title: Crimson 22" Premium Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for a great price.  Solid construction and well made.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill on the market.

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22". It was easy to assemble. The quality is great. I am new to charcoal grilling but have had no problems using this grill.
Results.Title: Easy to Assemble

Results.ReviewText: The kettle is a versatile grill that makes cooking a variety of foods at one time a snap. Nice grill marks and a little extra smoke with wood chips. Shutoff the air and grill cools down quickly
Results.Title: Delicious Food prepared simply

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po
Results.ReviewText: J'ai acheté car conseillé par un ami et super satisfait.
Results.Title: Fonctionne super bien

Results.ReviewText: This new Weber is a replacement for my 35+ year old Weber 22" grill, I really like the upgraded ash catcher and the inside vents.  The thermometer is very handy too.
Results.Title: MY THIRD WEBER, YOU CAN'T BEAT PREFECTION .

Results.ReviewText: Works very well and gave nice even heat. Just wish I’d picked the one with a place to hang the top.
Results.Title: Enjoying my grill

Results.ReviewText: Hands down the best grill I own. I have other smokers and grill but there really isn’t one that compare to this one.
Results.Title: Best grill you’ll ever own

Results.ReviewText: I bought a 26 in. Weber grill 28 years ago. I used it constantly during the summer and a couple turkeys on Thanksgiving and Christmas. The best grill ever. It finally bit the dust and I wanted to buy another but couldn't believe how much more they cost now. I understand the price increase after 28 years but I'm retired and can't afford one now. But Weber is still the best, I guarantee it.
Results.Title: The best

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Kettle years ago. I recently purchased a new one and I am glad to be barbecuing, with hickory chips again.
Results.Title: Happy to be barbecuing again.

Results.ReviewText: I’m not the griller, but my husband loves it! He says it is easy to clean and work with. I will say, I am loving the good food he has been making!
Results.Title: My husband loves it.

Results.ReviewText: I knew when I was going to buy a new charcoal grill it was going to be a Weber Kettle. It’s iconic and something everyone should own at some point so I finally bought one. Over the first month or so of use I can’t imagine why I always chose a gas grill for ‘convenience’ and never a charcoal grill. Look forward to grilling as much as possible. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: First Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Simple, well-designed, and easy to assemble. Built with good materials and keep it covered, so hoping to get many years of service out of it.
Results.Title: Well-Designed and Manufactured Grill

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill after my propane bbq started acting up and I absolutely love it!  Repaired my propane grill but I hardly ever use it as this is superior in every single way!  I will never cook a steak any other way than on this beauty!
Results.Title: Superior to propane!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your experience did not match your expectations. The lid holder is designed so that you can hang the lid on the bowl. We do not recommend modifications, and we would be more than happy to assist you with this. Please contact us at 1-800-446-1071. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: The grill cooks great, but the hook on the lid is very difficult to use. I only got it at the right angle to hook onto the grill 2xs out of 10. I even tested it! It even fell off once and the top handle bent and the thermometer no longer works! It was my 3rd time using it. It is just really poorly designed for a grill that I paid $175 for. Ultimately, I just bought a lid holder from Amazon. Why didn’t Weber think to include that?!
Results.Title: Lid needs to be redesigned!!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
